title: 15 A single-pole thermal-magnetic circuit breaker on a base

sources.citation: The 15 A single-pole thermal-magnetic molded-case breaker of NEC-region branch circuits, listed to UL 489. Paraphrased, not reproduced: it carries its rating continuously, and must trip within an hour at 135 % (for ratings up to 50 A) and within two minutes at 200 % (up to 30 A). Manufacturers' watts-loss figures put a pole at about 2 W at its rating, about 150 mV, so a contact resistance of 10 mΩ is taken (2.25 W at 15 A).

game-design inside manufacturer-style curves for NEC-region residential thermal-magnetic breakers (not IEC 60898): inverse-time thermal trips from a little above the rating (ultimate trip 1.25 ×; a 60 s time constant gives about 30 s at 200 %), and an instantaneous magnetic pickup published as a band near ten times the rating (8 to 12 ×, drawn per breaker). The fictional datasheet's band, tested: 135 %: 30 s to 1 h; 200 %: 10 s to 2 min; 500 %: 1 to 15 s; 13 × and above: within 1 ms.
game-design: a single-pole breaker on a 40 × 90 mm base, 70 mm tall, with the line terminal at the top and the load terminal at the bottom; standalone (no panel until P4); not modelled on a product.
